# `team.create`

Create a team

Session-only, organization owners. One permission covers every selected repository.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/create`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team create`
- MCP: `team_create`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
